summaries.en: President Trump demanded that five countries, including South Korea, dispatch warships to the Hormuz Strait to keep it open and safe, in anticipation of Iran's attempts to blockade it.
summaries.zh: 特朗普总统要求包括韩国在内的五个国家派遣军舰到霍尔木兹海峡，以应对伊朗封锁海峡的企图，确保海峡开放和安全。
